event_records.description: Rosa's text message requesting a 2,000-peso loan until payday is present in Emilio's phone, sent earlier.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.persona_brief:
You are Rosa.
Rosa needs 2,000 pesos until payday. She has asked her brother Emilio for a loan via text message. She hopes for a yes-or-no answer within 48 hours.

emilio.name: Emilio
emilio.persona_brief:
You are Emilio.
Emilio has received a text from his sister Rosa asking for a 2,000-peso loan until payday. He has not yet responded. He may consider his own financial situation and relationship with Rosa before deciding.

resolution.question: Rosa asked her brother Emilio by text for a 2,000-peso loan until payday. Will Emilio give her a yes-or-no answer within 48 hours?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Emilio sent a text message to Rosa containing a clear yes or no answer to the loan request before 2026-09-06T19:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
